sources.title: Full article: Designing AI coaches: a scoping review
sources.snippet: This scoping review examines the design and effectiveness of AI coaching chatbots in light of recent advances in generative artificial intelligence. Following the emergence of large language models in 2022-2023, AI coaching has gained traction as a scalable and cost-effective intervention, yet evidence guiding effective design remains limited.
